description: A python block synthesizes a monochrome PAL test pattern (625-line interlace timing, sync tips at 0, blanking at 0.3, a vertical-brightness gradient with a horizontal ramp); video_decode slices the syncs, assembles 576 rows per field and publishes grayscale PNG frames plus stats.
prompt: Decode a composite PAL video signal into image frames.

params.code:
def work(x, rate):
    rate = 4000000.0
    n = len(x)
    k0 = state.get('k', 0)
    k = k0 + np.arange(n)
    state['k'] = k0 + n
    line = 256                    # 64 us line at 4 MS/s (PAL)
    pos = k % line
    ln = (k // line) % 625
    act = (ln >= 45) & (ln < 621)
    ramp = np.clip((pos - 40) / 200.0, 0, 1)
    bright = ((ln - 45) % 576) / 575.0
    level = 0.3 + 0.7 * np.clip(0.65 * bright + 0.35 * ramp, 0, 1)
    y = np.where(act, level, 0.3)
    y = np.where(pos < 20, 0.0, y)                 # hsync, 5 us
    y = np.where((ln == 0) & (pos < 100), 0.0, y)  # vsync, 25 us
    y += 0.01 * np.random.randn(n)
    return y.astype(np.float64), rate
